target: bench.sh reconcile — removes a clean bench once its spec reaches done
cmd: source "$FIXTURES/bench-repo.sh"; bench_fixture_setup; cd work; export FACTORY_BENCH_DIR="$PWD/../benches"; mkdir -p .agentic; echo '{"bench":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; bench_fixture_spec . pr-open feature 001; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/bench.sh"; bench_reconcile; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; tracker_advance factory/specs/001-t.md done; bench_reconcile; jq -n --arg exists "$([ -d "$FACTORY_BENCH_DIR/feature" ] && echo yes || echo no)" '{exists: $exists}'
